title: Quantum--classical break-even in electronic dynamics of macrocyclic molecules
summary: Here we demonstrate quantum--classical break-even for chemical dynamics applications, reaching useful accuracy with a quantum-hardware wall-clock time comparable to that estimated for practical classical computing resources. To this end, we develop a workflow for problems that are hardware-native but classically hard. We target large ring-shaped molecules that map naturally onto quantum hardware with neighboring connections.
